title: Refactor UI Levels from Stories to Storybook Decorator
description: Currently the different UI levels in elements/ui are separate stories. Refactor them to use a storybook decorator instead, so levels can be toggled via toolbar/args rather than being individual stories.
summary: Refactored UI levels from separate per-level stories to a global storybook decorator. Added a Level toolbar dropdown (base/window/panel/overlay/temporary) to preview.ts globals alongside the existing Theme toolbar. Simplified withLevel.tsx to read from context.globals.level and wrap every story in LevelProvider with the appropriate background. Removed createLevelRender functions and ~165 level stories (Base/Window/Panel/Overlay/Temporary) across 33 story files. All 21 tests pass, storybook builds clean.
